abilities._comment: When this hits a hero, target dagger you control deals 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit (fires the dagger's ON_HIT). Go again is an engine keyword (card DB). Previously dealt generic damage not attributed to a dagger and never registered the dagger hit.

_comment: Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
